# SnapDropZoneRule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Validation` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Validation/Rules/GripRules.cs#L543)

Checks holders that can never take anything.

A [`SnapDropZone`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/SnapDropZone) accepts one named object or one tag, and either can be left
unset. Nothing throws when it is: the zone highlights, the object is dropped into it, and it
falls straight through - which reads as the trigger being wrong or the drop not registering,
and is a headset session to work out.

